description:
We're excited to showcase six real projects captured by a pro creator using Insta360 Ace Pro 2, X5, and GO Ultra. This video demonstrates the exact setups, mounts, and camera settings that made these shots possible, from floating third-person POVs to epic cliff dives, and underwater 360 shots.

Big thanks to @amirzakeri for pushing what's possible with Insta360. He takes advantage of tools like extended selfie sticks, invisible dive cases, and the AquaLens to achieve cinematic results whether filming 5.7K60fps slow-motion action, underwater adventures, or immersive POV footage.

💡 In this video, you'll see how to:
- Capture third-person POV with X5 Third-Person Backpack Mount
- Shoot stable, high-quality underwater footage with Insta360 Ace Pro 2 and GO Ultra
- Use the Invisible Dive Case Pro and Extended Selfie Stick effectively
- Maximize RAW or auto settings for flexible editing
- Create professional-level cinematic shots without bulky equipment
